learning_outcomes.text: Identify/recognize and clearly and in detail explain the main concepts, principles, theories, and basic methods of management associated with the field of mechanical engineering and the specialization.
Explain the manager's role in the organizational structure.
Explain the managers' attributes and responsibilities.
Recognize the conceptual framework of management in practical situations.
Apply specific tools for a manager's activity (SWOT analysis, Gantt chart, decision-making methods, transportation problems/plans, etc.).
Demonstrate an ethical attitude in business.
Utilize basic principles and methods from the management domain and apply them in processes specific to the specialization.
Develop professional projects by selecting, combining, and utilizing concepts, principles, methodologies, and technologies from the domain.
Select and apply basic concepts, principles, and methods from the domain for associated calculations.
Analyze and interpret the obtained results.
Select and analyze specific bibliographic sources in the field.
Demonstrate autonomy in learning specific domain issues.

Respect ethical principles, norms, and values in the correct and timely execution of professional tasks, by adopting a rigorous, efficient, and responsible work strategy in making decisions to solve problems.
Continuously inform and document oneself in their own field of activity by adequately using efficient methods and techniques for lifelong learning.

syllabus_topics: Origin and definition of the concept of management
Evolutions and current orientations in management
Approach to the concept of organizational structure
Conceptual approach to human resources management
Approach to the concept of quality
Evolution and definition of quality management
Approach to the concept of innovation
Determinant factors of innovation at the organizational level
Characteristics of the chemical industrial enterprise
Scheduling, launching, and monitoring of industrial production
Organization of auxiliary activities and enterprise services
Conceptual approach to the management of activities/works carried out by an organization

Evaluation of possibilities for developing flexible execution programs that can facilitate the coordination and monitoring of works associated with an organization using the Critical Path Method (CPM)
Development/leveling of the workforce diagram associated with activities/works carried out by an organization using CPM
Evaluation of possibilities for optimizing activities/works carried out by an organization using CPM
Scientific foundation of decisions. ELECTRE method.
Scientific foundation of transports carried out by an organization. Methods: NW Corner, minimum from column, minimum from row, minimum from matrix, potentials algorithm (optimization).
teaching_methods: Logical deduction facilitated by direct/indirect exploration of reality (e.g., demonstration)

assessment_methods.method: Summative evaluation test (final grid and classic test)
Seminar activities (active participation and evaluation test)

assessment_rules: The final evaluation result for a discipline is obtained by considering the scores and weights allocated to each activity. Whole grades from 1 to 10 will be awarded. A grade of 5 certifies the acquisition of minimal learning outcomes and the granting of corresponding study credits.
